decisions.statement: Every page of that page type is answered in this one answer.
The pages written are the pages the index names of that page type.
A page type carrying no property under the key is refused.
A key the page type says carries many values is refused.
A page type no page is of is refused rather than answered as no edit.
A key no page spells is refused.
A value that parses as no value is refused before any page is read.
A value naming anything the body would run is no value.
The value is written as the caller spells it rather than as text to quote.
An `after` the caller states places the key on every page.
Where the caller states no `after`, the key lands where the pages of that page type write it.
Which keys a page writes is read from the value the index files for that page.
A page the index files no value for gains the key last.
Every page is placed by the pages as they were before this change ran.
One page's key comes in by one edit over that page.
A page stating the key already is refused by its path.

definition: one value put under one key on every page of one page type
